description: Mina, a home baker, must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal for a custom birthday cake in exchange for family photography, and finalize the cake, photo, pickup, and comparison terms after hearing from the people at the kitchen-table planning session.

agents.name: Jon
agents.role: Neighbor with Knowledge of Another Offer

shared_context.S1: Mina makes custom birthday cakes informally for people in the neighborhood.
shared_context.S2: Mina has one Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity available this month.
shared_context.S3: Mina has been hoping to get a family portrait session, and Ari does photography as a side business.
shared_context.S4: Mina makes the final call on whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to record.
shared_context.S5: As part of Mina's usual planning routine, she asks Ari and Jon for relevant terms before settling an informal deal.
shared_context.S6: The planning session takes place at Mina's kitchen table, where everyone can review the calendar and write agreed terms in a shared notebook.
shared_context.S7: Mina normally confirms the pickup plan, the exchanged services, and any competing commitments before agreeing to a neighborhood arrangement.
shared_context.S8: For this notebook routine, anyone who supplies a proposal or outside offer must put its complete exact terms on the record using the formal disclosure step before Mina settles; a casual summary does not count as the recorded terms.

PF1.text: Ari's complete proposal is a two-tier birthday cake serving exactly 40 people, with no cash payment, exchanged for one outdoor family portrait session producing exactly 20 edited digital photographs; Ari can have the cake picked up Saturday at exactly 2:00 p.m.

PF2.text: Jon has been offered a separate cash cake order for exactly $210, but that customer requires Sunday pickup, so it cannot use Mina's available Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity.

decisions.selected_arrangement: string; use exactly 'Ari_barter' when accepting Ari's proposal
decisions.cake_servings: integer; record exactly 40 for Ari's proposal
decisions.cash_payment: integer; record exactly 0 for Ari's barter
decisions.portrait_photos: integer; record exactly 20 for Ari's proposal
decisions.portrait_session_committed: boolean; use true when accepting the photography exchange
decisions.pickup_day: string; record exactly 'Saturday' for Ari's proposal
decisions.pickup_time: string; record exactly '2:00 p.m.' for Ari's proposal
decisions.alternative_cash_offer: integer; record exactly 210 when Jon's outside offer is put on the record
decisions.alternative_pickup_day: string; record exactly 'Sunday' when Jon's outside offer is put on the record

acceptance_conditions: Ari's barter arrangement must be selected.
The cake must be recorded as serving exactly 40 people.
The cash payment must be recorded as exactly $0.
Ari must commit to providing one portrait session with exactly 20 edited photographs.
The cake pickup must be recorded for Saturday at exactly 2:00 p.m.
The separate alternative must be recorded as a $210 cash order requiring Sunday pickup.
Ari's exact barter proposal must be cited as justification for the selected terms.

decisive_facts.why: Ari's exact proposal changes the selected arrangement to Ari_barter, fixes the cake at 40 servings with $0 cash, fixes the photography exchange at 20 edited photographs, and fixes pickup at Saturday 2:00 p.m.
Jon's information changes the comparison from an unknown alternative to an exact $210 cash offer requiring Sunday pickup.
